prose: Digital infrastructure company SWI raised €800 million to upgrade its data centers, including facilities acquired from Genesis Digital Assets, a bitcoin miner tangled in the FTX bankruptcy, per the WSJ. Basis: the article is paywalled and only the standfirst was retrievable.
highlights: SWI raised €800M to upgrade data centers.
Some sites came from Genesis Digital, a bitcoin miner snarled in FTX's bankruptcy.
